risks.risk: Camera body model could differ from the claimed D810 (different Nikon DSLR with very different value).
risks.proof: Clear photo of the top LCD panel or body nameplate showing the exact model number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a generic/unspecified Nikon DSLR body, not the higher-value D810

risks.risk: Lens could be a different focal length or third-party lens, not a genuine 24-70mm.
risks.proof: Photo of the lens barrel with cap off, showing focal length and aperture markings.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unidentified generic zoom lens

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have shutter/sensor faults (common on older high-shutter-count DSLRs).
risks.proof: Video or photo of camera powered on, showing live view and shutter count on screen.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, memory card) could add hidden extra cost for buyer.
risks.proof: Photo of full kit including charger, battery, and box.
risks.if_unproven: priced as body + lens only, no accessories included

proof_requests: Photo of the camera's top plate or rear LCD clearly showing the model number (to confirm D810 vs another Nikon body).
Photo of the lens with the cap removed, showing focal length and aperture markings (to confirm 24-70mm).
Photo or video of the camera powered on, ideally showing shutter count in menu.
Photo of included accessories (battery, charger, box, memory card).
response.reason: The single photo does not clearly show the camera's model number or the lens markings, and no functional test is visible, so even a worst-case price cannot be safely assigned without confirming the actual model and lens identity.
